mostWorthwhile.text: Making the membrane patch was most worthwhile: seeing the heads face water and the tails face inward made the boundary easier to understand.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the sugar carrier felt a little predictable after adding the water channel, though the two-panel picture helped explain it.

surprise.text: I was surprised that oxygen crosses both ways, even though more enters the cell.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the goals and pictures explained the pairings, though several were the only available option.
